personal_information.description: Certified Accountant with 7+ years of experience in financial reporting, tax compliance, and management accounting for manufacturing and retail companies. Skilled in SAP, Oracle, and data-driven financial analysis. Proven track record of reducing operational costs and improving financial accuracy through process automation and internal controls.

description: Majored in Accounting with specialization in Management Accounting and Auditing.
Active in accounting student association, organized annual national accounting competition.
Final thesis on the impact of internal controls on financial reporting quality.
Oversee monthly and annual financial closing for 3 business units with combined revenue of IDR 500B.
Reduced month-end closing time from 10 days to 5 days by automating reconciliation processes in SAP.
Lead annual external audit coordination with Big 4 accounting firms, achieving zero material findings.
Prepared consolidated financial statements in compliance with PSAK and IFRS standards.
Supervised a team of 4 junior accountants and conducted quarterly performance reviews.
Filed monthly VAT and annual corporate income tax returns for 30+ client companies.
Conducted tax audit defense for 5 clients, successfully reducing assessed tax by 60%.
Performed statutory audits and financial due diligence for M&A transactions.
Trained clients on e-Filing system and DJP Online tax reporting platform.

projects.title: SAP ERP Implementation — Finance Module
projects.description: Led the finance module implementation of SAP S/4HANA for a 500-employee manufacturing company. Migrated 5 years of historical data, trained 20 users, and achieved go-live on schedule with 100% data accuracy.

projects.title: Automated Financial Reporting Dashboard
projects.description: Built a Power BI dashboard connected to SAP for real-time P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow reporting. Eliminated 40 hours/month of manual Excel reporting and reduced reporting errors by 90%.

projects.title: Cost Reduction Initiative — COGS Analysis
projects.description: Conducted detailed COGS analysis across 3 product lines, identifying IDR 2.3B in annual savings through supplier renegotiation and production process improvements.
